comments.content: Assembly name appears incorrect: the ViewModels types live in assembly Microsoft.CmdPal.Core, not Microsoft.CmdPal.Core.ViewModels. With the current name the rd.xml entries will not match the actual assembly and AOT trimming hints will be ignored.

Returning null for unknown item types will introduce null entries into the ToArray() result. Filter out nulls e.g. .Where(x => x != null) before ToArray() to avoid downstream NullReferenceExceptions and silent data loss.
